utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re still rallying people for the repair drive. I can stop by after errands and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you. Ask what’s still short on the list and let me know if they need help hauling anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I will. I’m heading out now and I’ll ask what’s still short on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the repair drive over tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll be ready for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is confirmed for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, that's right.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve mixed up the times, but I can still help out if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps, thanks. We could still use an extra pair of hands if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m free. Point me to whatever needs doing and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have missed the latest update, but I can help if you tell me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What changed since the last update? I want to make sure I’m helping with the right version.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the deep-clean supplies and a couple of paint jobs. I can walk you through the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, walk me through it and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Gus. I can take a look at the repair drive and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Gus. I’ll take a look and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where the repair drive is happening. Where are we headed?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The repair drive is over at the community center by the school. I’ll take you there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll meet you at the community center by the school after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is picking up nicely - I heard they’ve already got a few neighbors signed up to help this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds like a good turnout already. I’m going to pass the word along and see if anyone else nearby wants to join this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d help a lot - I’m hearing there’s still room if folks want to stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, is the repair drive still on for today? I need to know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, it’s still on. I can bring a few tools and some basic supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive and pass the plan along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll wait for the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Uli. I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’m checking who can help and what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help, but I may need to step back if it gets too much.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’ll keep an eye on the load, and if you need to step back, I’ll make sure we adjust the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive's picking up again this afternoon. I heard they're short a few hands, so if Eli can swing by, they'll put him right to work.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mm-hm, and they said he can start right in on the fence posts if he shows up before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late - what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just a few things left - we still need to finish the porch railing and check the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can handle the porch railing, and I’ll check the back gate too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up. Tell me what you need looked at.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the wiring in the front room and the hallway light. I can show you later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Show me when you have a minute, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, where should we meet for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s meet at the hardware store parking lot at 10.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad you brought it up, Hana. I can help gather people for the repair drive and keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely, I’ll check the details and then help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — I’ll help keep everyone coordinated while you check the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I missed what changed, but I can help if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can fill you in: the repair drive needs help with the broken screens, loose steps, and a few leaks. If you can take one of those, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can take the broken screens if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re moving fast on the repair drive. I can check back after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good idea. I can lend a ladder and my drill if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll stop by later and see what else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I need you to load the drive and check the connectors first. If anything looks loose, tighten it and tell me what you find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll load it now and check the connectors for anything loose.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling the repairs. If we can pin down the schedule, I’ll feel better.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s get the schedule nailed down first. Who’s coordinating the repairs, and when are they starting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d feel better if we had one person named and a start date on the calendar. Do we know who’s coordinating it yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in for the repair drive, Cleo. I’ll tell a few neighbors and make sure they know when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll note you in for it. Bring the neighbors and I’ll keep the supplies lined up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do, I’ll round up a few more neighbors and make sure they know the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check the school calendar and see when I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye. I really appreciate it — even one slot would help us get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the calendar tonight and let you know what slot I can take.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m lining up the first round of volunteers now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep the list moving and let you know if I need help filling any gaps.
